scenario: A `call` kwarg with a Float value reaches the integrator's cb as a Float argument (`DS_ARG_FLOAT`), through FN_CALL's name/value operand pairs (RDSC.4a.9.4) and libds's call bridge. Pins [NCBK.6.10]'s Float kind on its own, a non-integral value, so a runtime that sent it as an Int would fail. The ICOM.22.4 in its id is no clause: no document carries the ICOM prefix.
rules_ds:
service svc.x:
    kwarg temperature: Float
    no response

schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig
->
    call svc.x temperature: 22.5 nocooldown
